title: Nominal social-compliance cross-planner campaign preregistration for issue #6474
evidence_tier_note: Nominal benchmark evidence candidate ONLY, and only contingent on full, complete, native-or-declared-adapter campaign completion with declared provenance. This preregistration alone is not benchmark evidence and supports no claim until the full campaign completes under its own execution gate.

approval.scope: Approval gates the preregistration design (config and script changes). Production execution is separately gated via SLURM submission under a follow-up child issue.
approval.next_gate: Freeze the exact manifest, aggregation version, multiplicity family, and stop rules before any SLURM submission. This preregistration satisfies that Next gate.
approval.validity: Config/script changes only; no execution output is committed and no SLURM job is submitted by this preregistration.

provenance.scenario_content_hash_method: SHA-256 over the six selected scenario payloads serialized as canonical JSON (sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) in the frozen #6102 DECLARED_SCENARIOS order, loaded from configs/scenarios/classic_interactions.yaml.
provenance.aggregation_version: robot_sf.benchmark.aggregate social-compliance flatten/group path keyed to social-compliance-metric-contract.v1 (per-episode reducers: mean, median, p95, max; campaign reducers: mean, median, bootstrap_ci95)
provenance.analysis_script_status: preregistration stub: declares estimands only; does not execute the campaign

design.planner_execution_mode_note: goal runs natively; social_force and orca are velocity-vector planners that execute through declared benchmark-capable compatibility adapters (NATIVE_EXECUTION_MODES = {native, adapter}). Every row's mode must be recorded.

seed_policy.pairing: Paired seeds matched across planners within each seed; bootstrap resamples whole paired seed blocks.

design.scenario_source: Six frozen #6102 medium-band scenario identifiers copied verbatim from configs/scenarios/classic_interactions.yaml (the registered #6102 robot speed-tier campaign scenario source).
design.horizon_dt_note: Matches the #6481 preflight smoke so the social-compliance emission path exercised here is the same one already proven to survive a native/adapter cross-planner run.
design.coverage_formula: 6 scenarios x 3 planners x 30 seeds = 540 unique cells

estimands.scope: By metric family and scenario family; declared per planner pair.
estimands.definition: For each planner pair and metric family, the mean over episodes of the per-episode difference between the two planners' metric-family values, paired by seed and restricted to rows where the metric family is available for both planners in the pair.
estimands.support_and_denominators: Support counts and the contract denominator are declared beside every mean, median, percentile, or distributional statistic. Unavailable samples are excluded from numeric reducers, never zero-imputed.

multiplicity.rule: Stepwise Holm-Bonferroni adjusted p-values across the 15 exposed planner-pair-by-metric-family decisions. No unapproved composite social-compliance ranking is produced.

claim_boundary.target_claim: Estimate within-simulator planner-pair differences for the versioned social-compliance metric families (comfort_exposure and any other available families).
forbidden_claims: No universal planner superiority or universal-ranking claim.
No fairness, deployment-ethics, or welfare claim.
No safety, physical-severity, or real-world claim.
No composite social-compliance ranking beyond the declared per-estimand paired differences.
No claim beyond the simulator-defined, versioned social-compliance metric families.
claim_boundary.evidence_ceiling: Nominal benchmark evidence only for simulator-defined metrics, contingent on full campaign completion.

interpretation_boundary.scope: Within-simulator, six-scenario, three-planner, paired-seed comparison only.
interpretation_boundary.external_validity: None. Results do not generalize to other scenarios, planners, seeds, simulators, or real-world deployment.
interpretation_boundary.metric_class: diagnostic_proxy social-compliance metrics; simulation-only proxies for robot influence on pedestrians.
interpretation_boundary.ranking_note: Descriptive per-estimand paired differences only; not a planner ranking.

exclusions.rule: Fallback, degraded, missing, invalid, or unsupported rows are EXCLUDED from numeric reducers and reported with their status and reason. They are never zero-imputed and never counted as successful evidence.
exclusions.execution_mode_policy: Only native and declared benchmark-capable adapter rows are eligible. Fallback or degraded execution is recorded as unavailable and cannot count as success evidence.

stop_rules: Stop before execution on planner, scenario, row-count, or schema mismatch against the frozen design.
Stop with a blocked/partial classification if any row uses fallback or degraded execution, or if required provenance (config SHA, scenario hash, execution mode) is absent.
Exclude (do not zero-impute) fallback, degraded, missing, or invalid rows; report their status and support denominator explicitly.
Stop promotion of an estimand whose support is insufficient to compute the declared paired effect and bootstrap CI95, and report the insufficient-support reason.
No fairness, deployment-ethics, legibility, social-validity, safety, welfare, real-world, universal-ranking, or composite-score claim may be made from this campaign.

Stop and record a blocker if the frozen manifest, aggregation version, multiplicity family, or stop rules drift after execution begins; no dimension, threshold, or preregistration clause may be changed after registered execution begins.
Treat the result as diagnostic/blocked rather than benchmark-success evidence if the full 540-cell native-or-adapter matrix is not complete with declared provenance.

execution_gating.production_execution: Separately gated via a follow-up SLURM child issue created after this preregistration is merged.
execution_gating.authorization_note: Production execution requires its own authorization gate; this preregistration does not authorize any SLURM submission.

related_issues.follow_up_slurm_child: to be created after this preregistration is merged

validation_commands: DISPLAY= MPLBACKEND=Agg SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy uv run python -m robot_sf.benchmark.cli validate-config --matrix configs/scenarios/issue_6474_social_compliance_nominal.yaml
